FULL TEXT:
OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT MEDICAL AND HEALTH OFFICER: MAHABUBABAD
NOTIFICATION FOR CERTAIN CATEGORIES OF POSTS UNDER VARIOUS PROGRAMMES
OF NHM FOR 2026-27
Rc.No.E1/1636/NHM-Rectt./2026 Dt: 14-10-2026
Notification No.03/2026
Applicantions are invited to fill up certain categories of posts (67) on contract basis in
Various Programmes under NHM in Mahabubabad District, applications are invited w.e.f
22.10.2026 to 29.10.2026. All the eligible candidates are requested to submit their applications
along with self attested of all required certificates copies mentioned in the notification either by
person or through the post at O/o District Medical & Health Officer, Mahabubabad, F-25, IDOC-
Mahabubabad, Mahabubabad District on or before 29.10.2026 till 5.00PM. (District Selection
Committee is not responsible for postal delays).
The application form and guidelines and the details of terms and conditions along with
notification can be down loaded from the official website www.mahabubabad.telangana.gov.in.
Sd/- Sd/-
District Medical and Health Officer District Collector
Mahabubabad Mahabubabad
